section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Instruments and Sender Gauges
title: Combination Meter and Gauge (Digital Type)

content.description: Physical layout diagram showing the back of a digital combination meter with three connector blocks and numbered terminals. The main connector area shows terminals numbered 35-47 (top row) and 41-47 (middle row). Below are two smaller connector blocks: one with terminals 48-54 (arranged in 2 rows), and another with terminals 56-61 (arranged in 2 rows). The right side shows the terminal arrangement on the meter circuit board with numbered terminals from 8-47 arranged in various patterns.

Electrical circuit diagram showing the combination meter system with connections between various components. The diagram shows four main blocks at the bottom: TACHO, TEMP, FUEL, and SPEED, POWER SOURCE INPUT INTERFACE OUTPUT INTERFACE on the left side, connected to CRUISE PILOT on the right side. Multiple numbered terminals (1-9, 10, 12, 9 at top, and various numbers 18-55 throughout) connect to these components. The diagram includes labels for signals like SPEED SCALE CHANGE, FUEL, TEMP, OIL, BATT, SPEED, BRAKE, LIGHT, and others.
labels: SPEED, POWER SOURCE INPUT INTERFACE OUTPUT INTERFACE
